name: Sanctuary
summary: Ismark wanted Ireena behind walls. Vallaki has walls. Whether it has anywhere safe inside them is another question.

stages.journal: We brought Ireena to Vallaki, as Ismark wanted. She means to ask for sanctuary at St. Andral's Church.
objectives: Take Ireena to Father Lucian at St. Andral's
stages.hint: Take Ireena to Father Lucian at St. Andral's Church in Vallaki.

stages.journal: Father Lucian cannot promise Ireena sanctuary: the bones that made his church holy ground are gone.
objectives: Recover the bones of St. Andral
Find Ireena somewhere to stay meanwhile
stages.hint: Get St. Andral's bones back for Father Lucian; meanwhile Urwin Martikov at the Blue Water Inn can give Ireena a room.

stages.journal: Ireena has taken a room at the Blue Water Inn while we deal with Vallaki's troubles. The Martikovs keep a close watch on their door.
objectives: Find Ireena true sanctuary, or take her with us again
stages.hint: Once St. Andral's bones are back, take Ireena to the church; or ask her to travel with you again. She's at the Blue Water Inn.

stages.journal: Ireena has taken sanctuary at St. Andral's Church, holy ground once more. For the first time since her father died, she slept through the night.
Ireena chose to keep travelling with us. Walls didn't save her father, she says; we might do better.
Ireena won't stay in a town ruled by the devil's friends. She means to go on toward Krezk, with us.
